contexts.text: Therefore they cannot approach the first threshold of the court of the Heavens. AC 1820.
He got into a Society which is in the first threshold of Heaven, but could not breathe.
Such do not see the first threshold of wisdom.
Such are in the Lord's Kingdom, but on the threshold.
The sense of the letter is turned into the spiritual sense at the first threshold of Heaven.
Moses was admitted no further than to the first threshold of Heaven...
A holy external without an internal penetrates only to the first threshold of Heaven, and is there dissipated.
Hence he who is not in the idea of the Divine from which is Heaven, cannot be elevated to the first threshold of Heaven...
When such come to the first threshold of the Ultimate Heaven, they begin to be tortured. HH 525:2.

The Angels of the lowest Heaven cannot ascend to the first threshold of the perfections of the Angels of the Middle Heaven; nor these to the first threshold of the perfections of the Angels of the Highest Heaven. Explained.
If Truths do not become of the will, they are only in the threshold to man...
The drought in the threshold () = the total destruction of truth.
